'''Linksabers''' were a pair of [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] connected by a [[Fibercord/Legends|Fibercord]]. Used by the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Acolyte [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], the linksabers allowed for each swing to easily flow into the next.<ref name="BF2 classic">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' {{C|Xbox Live pack}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The weapon first appeared in a ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' DLC exclusive to the [[Wikipedia:Xbox|Xbox]]. Asajj Ventress' Linksabers are used in a similar manner to real-life [[Wikipedia:Nunchaku|''Nunchaku'']].<ref name="BF2 classic" />
